{
  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "text": "Apple adopted ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers) starting FY 2019, so it stopped reporting under the legacy 'Revenues' concept and began using 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' instead.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year, SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'Revenues' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_legacy, SUM(CASE WHEN concept = 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax' THEN value_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_new
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
  AND concept IN ('Revenues','RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax')
  AND fiscal_year >= 2018
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "After 2018, Apple's filings for the 'Revenues' concept have period_frame = NULL (duplicate facts) and the edgar.revenue_facts table only retains rows where period_frame IS NOT NULL, causing those later values to be omitted.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period_frame IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_frame_rows
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
  AND concept = 'Revenues'
  AND fiscal_year >= 2019
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year;"
    },
    {
      "text": "The concept tag for revenues changed after 2018 (e.g., a different namespace or local name), so the stored concept string no longer matches 'Revenues', making those facts invisible when filtering for that exact concept.",
      "how_to_test": "SELECT DISTINCT concept, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM edgar.revenue_facts
WHERE cik = 320193
  AND fiscal_year >= 2019
  AND concept LIKE '%Revenue%'
GROUP BY concept
ORDER BY cnt DESC;"
    },
    {
      "text": "A reference‑data gap exists: the unified semantic layer's foreign key from revenue_fact to company is broken for Apple after 2018 (e.g., missing or mismatched cik in the company table), so queries that rely on the layer return no rows for later years.",
      "how_to_test": "SHOW DQ ALL INVALID TABLE lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact;
-- Then check if any invalid rows involve Apple's cik:
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.explainwhy.explainwhy_usl.revenue_fact
WHERE cik = '320193'
  AND fiscal_year >= 2019
  AND concept = 'Revenues';"
    }
  ]
}
